title: IEC, ANSI/IEEE/NEMA, API/ASME & Chinese GB/T Power Plant Standards Crosswalk
description: Open engineering crosswalk dataset mapping European IEC/ISO/EN, North American ANSI/IEEE/NEMA/API/ASME, and Chinese GB/T & JB/T standards for hybrid power stations, substations, and oil/gas facilities in Iraq and MENA. Maintained by The Power Contractor (https://pc-cn.com).
